title: Weaving sustainability into India’s textile future through circular economy
description: With over 70% of India's 7.8 million tonnes of annual textile waste now recycled and Rs. 27,434 crore (US$ 3.10 billion) in MoUs signed under PM MITRA Parks, the sector is positioning itself to generate nearly one lakh green jobs and a Rs. 33,505.50 crore (US$ 3.50 billion) recycling market by 2030.
